name: Awei PA32 30000mah 22.5W Fast Charging Multifunctional Powerbank
description:
Awei 30000mAh Power Bank – Fast Charging, Stylish & Reliable

Key Features:

Massive 30000mAh Capacity – Stay powered all day, ideal for travel, work, and emergencies.

22.5W Fast Charging – Advanced technology delivers rapid charging, reducing waiting time.

Multi-Port Convenience – Multiple outputs (Type-C & USB) to charge several devices at once.

Smart Digital Display – Real-time battery level indicator so you never run out unexpectedly.

Superior Safety Protection – Prevents overcharging, overheating, and short circuits.

Futuristic Mecha-Style Design – Bold, durable, and stylish design with a strong grip.

🔋 Upgrade your charging experience with the powerful and stylish Awei 30000mAh Power Bank – built for performance, safety, and style.

6-Month Official Warranty
